from_speaker: Most of Amazon, Google and Microsoft’s capex
capacity mostly used by OpenAI and Anthropic
neither of whom have the money to pay
without continual infusions of more capital
our_interpretation: The claim contains two majority tests: more than half of capex funds the relevant capacity, and more than half of that capacity's use is attributable to OpenAI and Anthropic.
The main reading aggregates the three hyperscalers, while also requiring company-level results to expose differences.
Use January–March 2026, the latest completed reporting quarter before the post, for the ongoing spending, allocation and financing observations.
Treat the allocation as an estimate in the context of the author's surrounding capacity estimates. The accounting treatment of capex is not specified.
Current use is the plain reading. Future contracted use should be reported separately.
Continuing financing dependence means operating receipts and available cash cannot cover payment obligations without repeated external funding.
criteria.support_condition: Matched spending and allocation records establish both majority tests, and both labs' cash-flow and obligation records establish continuing dependence on external funding.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that either majority test fails, or that either lab can sustainably meet its obligations without continuing external funding.
